about:
# Best Around (Revisited)

**You're the best around, and now the game knows it.** Best Around (Revisited) plays a sound every
time you level up or earn an achievement. When you die, it plays something more fitting.

## What it does

- **Sounds on events.** Plays a special notification sound when a player levels, dies, or earns an achievement.
- **Pick your own sounds.** Each event has a checklist of sounds. Check as many as you like and a random
  one plays each time. Leave the list empty to silence that event.
- **No pile-ups.** If the same event fires again within a few seconds, for example dying twice in a void
  zone, the sound plays once instead of overlapping itself.
- **Your volume, your channel.** Sounds play on the Master channel by default, or on SFX or Music if you
  want them to follow that slider.

## Setting it up

Type `/bar` (or `/bestaround`), or go to **Options › AddOns › BestAround Revisited**. Each event has:

1. An **Enabled** checkbox.
2. A **Sounds** list. Check the ones you want; one is picked at random.
3. A **Test** button to hear it right away.

Settings are saved per profile. Switch, copy, or reset profiles under the **Profiles** page.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/bar` | Open the options |
| `/bar test` | Play the achievement sound |
| `/bar test level` | Play the level-up sound |
| `/bar test death` | Play the death sound |

## Supported clients

One download works on all of these:

- **Retail** (The War Within and Midnight)
- **Mists of Pandaria Classic**
- **Classic Era**
- **WoW: Forever (Classic Plus)**

releases.name: Automatic CurseForge releases
releases.notes:
A packaging release: the sounds and options work exactly as in 1.8.0. Best Around (Revisited) now reaches CurseForge automatically with every release, and the README in the download is a new player-friendly guide to setting it up.

## Changes
- New README: what each event does, how to pick sounds, and the commands.

## Supported clients
Retail 12.1 / 12.0.7 / 11.0.7 / 11.0.5, MoP Classic 5.5.0, Classic Era 1.15.6, WoW: Forever (Classic Plus) 1.60

## Install
Download `BestAroundRevisited-1.8.1.zip` and extract it into `Interface\AddOns\`.

releases.name: Pick a set of sounds per event; death sound no longer stacks
releases.notes:
Each event can now play a random pick from any set of sounds you choose, and the death sound no longer stacks on top of itself when you die several times in quick succession.

## Changes
- Each event (level-up, achievement, death) now has a checklist of sounds instead of a single dropdown. Check as many as you like and a random one plays each time the event fires.
- Leaving an event's checklist empty silences that event; the test buttons and `/bar test` will tell you in chat when nothing is selected.
- Your existing sound choices are migrated automatically, including when you switch or copy profiles.
- Dying repeatedly within a few seconds (e.g. spirit-healer bounces, void zones) plays the death sound once instead of overlapping copies.
- Stopped the addon from trying to load its README as an addon file.

## Supported clients
Retail 11.0.5 / 11.0.7 / 12.0.7 / 12.1.0, Classic Beta 1.60, Classic Era 1.15.6, MoP Classic 5.5.0

## Install
Download `BestAroundRevisited-1.8.0.zip` and extract it into `Interface\AddOns\`.

releases.name: New sounds: Coffin Dance, Pac-Man, and more Dumb Ways to Die
releases.notes:
Six new sounds to choose from — Coffin Dance, the Pac-Man death jingle, and four shorter cuts of Dumb Ways to Die — all leveled to match the existing clips.

## Changes
- Added Coffin Dance and the Pac-Man death jingle as new sound options.
- Added four Dumb Ways to Die variants: "hai hai hai", the outro, a short cut, and "so many ways".
- Coffin Dance and Pac-Man death are volume-matched to the existing Dumb Ways to Die clip, so switching sounds won't blast you.
- Your current sound choices are unchanged; pick the new ones from the dropdown in `/bar`.

## Supported clients
Retail 11.0.5 / 11.0.7 / 12.0.7 / 12.1.0, Classic Beta 1.60, Classic Era 1.15.6, MoP Classic 5.5.0

## Install
Download the zip and extract it into `Interface\AddOns\`.

releases.name: Classic Beta 1.60 support + Ace3 r1403
releases.notes:
Adds support for the WoW Forever **Classic Beta** client (1.60, interface 16001) and fixes two long-standing bugs.

## Changes
- **Classic Beta 1.60 support** — added interface `16001`.
- **Ace3 updated to Release-r1403** — picks up upstream fixes for the 12.x / 1.60 client API changes (options panel checkboxes and tooltips no longer error).
- **Fixed missing default sounds on fresh installs** — new profiles errored on first level-up because the default sound files resolved to nil. Existing installs were unaffected.
- **Per-category Enabled toggles now work** — unticking Achievements / Levels / Deaths actually silences that event. Test buttons still play regardless, so you can preview a sound while it's disabled.

## Supported clients
Retail 12.1 / 12.0, Classic Beta 1.60, Classic Era 1.15, MoP Classic 5.5

## Install
Download `BestAroundRevisited-1.6.0.zip` and extract it into `Interface\AddOns\` (it unpacks to `Interface\AddOns\BestAroundRevisited\`).
